answer.finalSql: SELECT date_trunc('month', "date") AS "month", SUM("daily_new_deaths") AS "deaths" FROM "86440223-249d-4b3d-9be4-159a4e615e0a" WHERE year("date") = 2022 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
answer.assistantText: This shows total US deaths for each month of 2022 from the US deaths dataset, drawn as a pie chart. I kept the same query as the "Monthly US deaths in 2022" chart on this dashboard, so only the chart type changes.
